why: Base UI hardcodes the Toast viewport label `Notifications` and the Combobox `Dismiss`; the catalog only works if our wrappers can override both (docs/v3/concepts/quality-contract.md section 10 Q4, P1). Q4 gates G1 before any primitive ships.
what: tools/spikes/provider-q4/** (own package.json: @base-ui/react 1.9.0, axe-core and @axe-core/playwright 4.14.0, playwright-core 1.63.0, react and react-dom 19.3.0; axe-core is only a transitive dep of lighthouse today) and docs/v3/spikes/provider-q4.md. No packages/basalt-ui file: the real wrappers belong to prim-p3b (Combobox) and prim-p4 (Toast), which wait on this contract.
must_not_touch: consumer repos (scratch copies live in the OS temp dir)
contract: docs/v3/concepts/quality-contract.md section 10 Q4 is frozen; REFUTED records `fork the wrapper part, not the catalog`, never applies it.
change: Write <=40-line throwaway wrappers over Base UI Toast viewport and Combobox in the spike taking `label` and `dismissLabel` props. Render with non-English overrides, open each overlay, settle, run axe with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21aa, wcag22aa. Record the prop names and where the string reaches the DOM (aria-label or text); prim-p3b and prim-p4 adopt them.
commits: One non-package commit `chore: spike provider-q4 harness and verdict`, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: run.ts JSON plus the verdict doc; run twice, attach both outputs.
acceptance: run.ts JSON has `toastLabelOverridable` and `comboboxDismissOverridable` (true), `defaultEnglishLeaks` (0), `axeSeriousCritical` (0, overlays open)
The doc names the two wrapper prop names and the DOM attribute each reaches
`bun tools/spikes/provider-q4/run.ts` exits 0, prints one JSON object with the keys above (0 = harness ran, not hypothesis held)
docs/v3/spikes/provider-q4.md has headings Question, Method, Measurements, Verdict, Then, Affects and the `verdict` lines
out_of_scope: The real wrappers; the format and messages catalog (qa-i2); other overlays.
envelope: Harness: tools/spikes/<dir>/ has its own package.json (exact pins); bun.lock and node_modules gitignored there (must_not_touch package.json and bun.lock = repo root only). Passes root oxlint; no *.test.* files; Chrome via the playwright-core pattern of packages/basalt-ui/tests/layout/harness.ts; docs/v3 on master before filing; synthetic data only, private repos as counts and hashed ids.
verdict: `Q4: PASS|REFUTED` (REFUTED if an override is not the accessible name, default English `Notifications` or `Dismiss` stays in the DOM, or axe is serious or critical); `Verdict:` equals the Q4 line. run.ts `verdict` pass|refuted by the same rule.
